description: ScoreLUT head: residual LUTs emit a SCORE SPACE (n_outputs=m*k=4096) instead of D=384; logits produced DIRECTLY via per-token gather over the score table (logit(v)=sum_j w_v[j]*S[j,code_v[j]]), no D-readout matmul. Codes learned via query-latent<->slot-key soft-assign (directed), argmax-gather at deploy. Dual eval soft+hard. residual_tph 128->16 for ~param-neutral (~88M). vs exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656. Tests the user's idea: produce logits directly with the residual LUTs via a codebook (token codes).
